session.how: The installed Desktop bundle's own app-server binary launched the way the bundle launches it (env CODEX_INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_OVERRIDE="Codex Desktop", LOG_FORMAT=json, -c features.code_mode_host=true, then app-server over stdio) and driven over JSON-RPC with Desktop's clientInfo, in a disposable CODEX_HOME with auth.json copied and otel exporters pointed at a local sink. The running Desktop GUI and its data were not touched.
session.launch_recipe_source: ChatGPT.app Contents/Resources/app.asar: spawn env CODEX_INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_OVERRIDE defaults to `Codex Desktop`; initialize clientInfo {name: codex_desktop, title: Codex Desktop}; running GUI process: codex -c features.code_mode_host=true app-server --analytics-default-enabled -c plugins...

sanitization.identities: creator_user_id, creator_account_id, host name and emails re-mapped consistently; OTLP user.email, user.account_id, host.name attributes removed; the app-server remoteControl installationId -> 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000d1
sanitization.vendor_text: Codex-authored bodies (base_instructions.text, developer-role input_text over 200 chars, world_state host_skills body) replaced by same-length filler keeping the first line
sanitization.opaque: encrypted reasoning and spawn_agent message payloads (gAAAAA...) replaced by same-length filler
sanitization.kept: record order, ordinal, timestamps, every id, record types, image data URL, the 1 MiB elided command output, unicode text
sanitization.compression: rollout-main.jsonl.gz and appserver-transcript.jsonl.gz are gzip of the JSONL (2560338 and 2256875 bytes uncompressed) so the corpus stays under 2 MiB without shrinking the 2173661-byte line; written deterministically (level 9, mtime 0, original member name)
sanitization.account: account fingerprints normalized without changing record shapes: rate_limits plan_type/planType -> plus, primary used_percent/usedPercent -> 0, credits balance -> 1000.0000000000, resets_at/resetsAt -> 1792108800; timezone (turn_context and <timezone> in environment context) -> UTC, current_date kept as captured; terminal.type and the user-agent terminal token -> xterm-256color
sanitization.revised: 2026-10-13: installationId re-mapped and account normalization; files sizes and sha256 recomputed from the committed bytes

rollout-subagent.jsonl.native: separate rollout per subagent thread; session_meta.session_id is the parent's, id is the child's

rollout-fork.jsonl.native: new rollout per fork; parent history referenced by session_meta.history_base and the ordinals continue from it

appserver-transcript.jsonl.gz.native: every JSON-RPC message between the driver and the app-server, {t, dir, msg}; the live stream Desktop's GUI consumes

otlp.jsonl.native: OTLP/HTTP JSON from the app-server, every log record kept, spans reduced as in codex-cli
